name: clawhunt-1520-structured-data-api
notes: 本契约是双向白名单：请求只能引用模板 id，模板 SQL 只能引用 allowed_views，结果列只能落在模板 selectable_fields 内。
客户端不提交 SQL 文本；SQL 只存在于本配置文件，且在加载时与每次执行前都要通过语句白名单检查。
exposed_via_api=false 的模板只允许本地运维使用（benchmark_cross_join 用于验证超时防线）。

templates.title: 按地区汇总销售额
templates.description: 指定日期区间内，按销售大区汇总订单数与销售额，可按地区、渠道过滤。
templates.sql:
SELECT region,
       SUM(orders) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS revenue
FROM v_sales_daily
WHERE date_iso BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to
  AND (:region IS NULL OR region = :region)
  AND (:channel IS NULL OR channel = :channel)
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY revenue DESC, region ASC
LIMIT :limit

templates.title: 按日营收趋势
templates.description: 指定日期区间内逐日订单数与销售额，可按渠道过滤。
templates.sql:
SELECT date_iso,
       SUM(orders) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS revenue
FROM v_sales_daily
WHERE date_iso BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to
  AND (:channel IS NULL OR channel = :channel)
GROUP BY date_iso
ORDER BY date_iso ASC
LIMIT :limit

templates.title: 品类营收占比
templates.description: 指定日期区间的品类营收与占比，占比以同一区间总营收为分母。
templates.sql:
SELECT category,
       SUM(orders) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(revenue_cents) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(revenue_cents) FROM v_category_revenue WHERE date_iso BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to), 0), 2) AS share_pct
FROM v_category_revenue
WHERE date_iso BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY revenue DESC, category ASC
LIMIT :limit

templates.title: 地区 x 渠道矩阵
templates.description: 指定日期区间内的地区与渠道交叉汇总，用于 OLAP 切片展示。
templates.sql:
SELECT region,
       channel,
       SUM(orders) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS revenue
FROM v_sales_daily
WHERE date_iso BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to
GROUP BY region, channel
ORDER BY region ASC, revenue DESC, channel ASC
LIMIT :limit

templates.title: 客户分层汇总
templates.description: 指定日期区间内按客户分层汇总订单与销售额。
templates.sql:
SELECT segment,
       SUM(orders) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS revenue
FROM v_segment_summary
WHERE date_iso BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY revenue DESC, segment ASC
LIMIT :limit

templates.title: 畅销商品榜
templates.description: 指定日期区间内按销售额排序的商品明细汇总。
templates.sql:
SELECT product_name,
       category,
       SUM(quantity) AS units,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS revenue
FROM v_product_rank
WHERE date_iso BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to
GROUP BY product_name, category
ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_name ASC
LIMIT :limit

templates.title: 订单明细抽样
templates.description: 明细类查询：SQL 不写 LIMIT，由第三层统一截断到请求上限并返回 truncated 标记。
templates.sql:
SELECT sale_id,
       date_iso,
       region,
       channel,
       category,
       quantity,
       ROUND(amount_cents / 100.0, 2) AS amount
FROM v_sales_enriched
WHERE date_iso BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to
ORDER BY sale_id ASC

templates.title: 超时防线基准查询（仅本地）
templates.description: 自连接全量视图用于验证查询超时中断；不对外暴露，避免占用服务端资源。
templates.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pairs
FROM v_sales_enriched a, v_sales_enriched b
